name: 360 Security Technology Inc.
summary: 360 Security Technology Inc. operates as an Internet and security service provider in China. The company offers security products, such as 360 Security Guard, 360 Mobile Guard, and 360 Security Browser. Its products include computer security, safe internet, system emergency, system tools, lifestyle and leisure, mobile phone security, performance optimization, 360 mall, and digital security products.
